 Community Watchlist Portfolio Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Petrol price reduced by Re1 per litre; diesel increased by Rs2 per litre
 Dawn • 20 Nov 2026, 10:50 PM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f The government has set petrol at Rs322 per litre and high-speed diesel (HSD) at Rs357 from Nov 21, Dawn reported. Petrol’s rate was cut by Re1, while diesel became Rs2 more expensive, ending a 12-day run of petrol reductions. The latest change follows a shift to frequent revisions tied to international market movements.
 Petrol carries Rs114 per litre in government taxes and duties, compared with Rs100 on diesel. A 30-day arrangement announced on Nov 2 has refineries absorb a combined Rs15 billion contribution to the petroleum levy, supporting a Rs14.71 cut in the petrol price for consumers. The fuel relief scheme covers motorcycles, rickshaws and vehicles up to 800cc, while diesel is widely used in heavy transport and power plants.
 At a glance
 Petrol is priced at Rs322 per litre from Nov 21, while HSD costs Rs357.
 Refineries are to shoulder a combined Rs15 billion levy contribution over 30 days.
 The fuel subsidy covers motorcycles, rickshaws and vehicles up to 800cc.
